## Checklist

- [ ] One story, on its own branch (`feat/<story>`, `fix/<story>`, `docs/<topic>` or `chore/<topic>`)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests that were written first, and `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] New user-facing texts go through `t()`, in both `sv.json` and `en.json`
- [ ] The story's status markers in `docs/features/` and `docs/FEATURES.md` are up to date
- [ ] No secrets, private paths or personal data in the diff
